Cyborg Cockroaches Developed for Medical Drug Delivery

Australian scientists have developed cyborg cockroaches capable of delivering lifesaving drugs. These insects have been trained to carry and deploy medication, potentially aiding in medical missions. The research focuses on utilizing the insects' natural abilities for targeted drug delivery.
